thread:
harper: Postmortem posted for today's authz blip. Short summary: an unusual token-validation path + a deploy that left stale permission entries. Audit exporter also dropped events during the rollback window. Full doc: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2951-authz
pagerduty-bot: Incident created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2951122334 status=postmortem, severity=P2
harper: I want to capture concrete follow-ups here: 1) token validation test harness + CI gate, 2) deploy-time perm-map invariant check, 3) audit export reliability and missing-event detection, 4) secrets rotation TTL scan + alerting. Call out owners and ETA.
devon: I'll pick #1 (token harness). Plan: lightweight unit matrix in CI + nightly full replay that exercises cache + rotation timing. ETA 6 business days. I'll include expired/rotated token scenarios and a `--repro-seed` flag.
yasmin: I'll take #3 (audit exporter). Will add producer side heartbeats, a sink-side sequence verifier, and an alert when gaps > 90s. ETA 5 business days. Need confirmation of current retention and backup access.
sre: I'll own #4 (secrets TTL). Plan: k8s CronJob scanner, Prom metric `secrets_ttl_drift_total`, and PD rule if drift > 1% in any namespace. ETA 4 business days. Will open tracker.
harper: I'll take #2 (perm-map invariant). Idea: pre-deploy check that rejects diffs increasing privileges for roles in the admin whitelist. ETA 5 business days.
devon: CI vs nightly question: I propose PR smoke tests (fast) + nightly heavy replays. Example CLI:
```
tools/authz-test --smoke
tools/authz-test --nightly --repro-seed=sha256
```
yasmin: For audit, I'll add a contract test to producer CI so formatting/schema changes fail fast. Also adding a small backfill plan in case retention blocks recovery.
sre: Created tracker SEQ-2951 and added tasks + owners: https://redwood.internal/trackers/SEQ-2951
pagerduty-bot: Reminder: follow-up review meeting scheduled by harper for 2024-12-12 14:00 UTC. Add notes to the postmortem doc.
harper: Two asks: (A) link PRs and tracker numbers here, (B) update this thread with major milestones (PR opened, CI passing, alert live). We'll close when prod shows stable metrics for 72h.
devon: Opening PR now and will paste link here when ready.
yasmin: I'll start the schema contract test and ping infra for retention details.
sre: Deployed TTL scanner to staging; exposing `secrets_ttl_drift_total` and creating a dashboard tile. Will add PD rule next.
devon: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inc/platform/pull/9999 includes CI matrix + nightly job
harper: Thanks. If anything blocks owners, call it out and we can reassign. Closing assignment phase. :thumbsup:
